exceptions.reason: Accepted documented risk for SUPPLY-86eeb375. GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 affects only unstable React Server Component APIs. probectl ships a client-only BrowserRouter with basename /ui, and the named guard rejects RSC APIs, RSC build dependencies, RSC entrypoints, server-action directives, and any loss of that exact browser-router seam. No compatible patched react-router-dom release is published as of 2026-07-28. A new advisory, affected-range drift, installed-version change, RSC/server-action adoption, audit clearance, or expiry fails closed and reopens review.

Accepted documented risk for SUPPLY-1dbf9837. GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff is a Windows-only alternate-path bypass in Vite server.fs.deny. probectl pins Vite 5.4.21 only as local dev/build tooling; Vite is absent from the shipped browser bundle and Go binaries, and the production-only npm audit is unaffected. A disruptive Vite 8 major upgrade is deliberately deferred. A new advisory, affected-range drift, installed-version change (including a planned Vite bump), production reachability, audit clearance, or expiry fails closed and reopens review. Revisit on production reachability or the next planned Vite upgrade, whichever comes first.

Accepted documented risk for SUPPLY-f205d4eb if the exact historical transitive node reappears: brace-expansion 1.1.16 was reachable only through local dev/build glob tooling, never shipped in the browser runtime, and received no untrusted product input; no patched 1.x exists. The current lock uses patched 5.0.8, so this standing exception is dormant and accepts nothing today. A new advisory, advisory-range drift, any installed-version change, production reachability, or expiry fails closed.
